dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: One... Two... Should need to make a few more...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Some topical injury ointments. One of our tribesmen — the idiot — put way too much weight on the barbell for his squats. He lost control and threw out his back.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: He's just lucky others reacted so fast. If they hadn't managed to rush in to stabilize the barbell...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: *sigh* I gave him a detailed, clear training plan, and specifically warned him multiple times to have me spot him if he wanted to push himself with heavier weights.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: But no, the fool got all full of himself, had to try on his own, and refused to listen to everyone else.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Now he's stuck with a busted back. Even my special ointments can't cure him overnight.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: What a pain... Now I'll have to go and give them another safety lecture in a few days...
